scope: Two-training-seed amendment to the paper-baseline plan after the user reduced the active fixed-model/task confirmation to seeds 42 and 43. This artifact does not authorize an automatic launch and does not change the active I0/I8 experiment.

known: No protocol-matched standard LoRA rank-32 result exists.
unobserved: All seed-43 I8 training and evaluation results.
All protocol-matched standard LoRA rank-32 results.

superseded_active_scope.future_seed44: A later seed-44 extension must be disclosed as subsequent work and cannot be silently folded into the two-seed decision.
superseded_active_scope.interpretation: The original three-seed standard-LoRA superiority gate is unevaluable under the amended scope; it is neither passed nor failed.

launch_policy.earliest_launch: Only after seed-43 I0 and I8 records and postverification artifacts are complete, the active controller is terminated, and the frozen two-seed gate implementation and tests pass.
do_not_launch_if: The I8 two-seed fixed-model/task confirmation does not pass all four required unfiltered/filtered gates.
The Phase-1 controller or any provenance-locked Phase-1 process is still active.
The experiment owner has not allocated enough capacity for two complete training/evaluation runs and their fixed checkpoint-retention protocol.
Any required launcher, contract, verifier, or evaluation protocol differs from the frozen values below.

standard_initializer.initial_delta_weight: exactly zero because B is initialized to zero
standard_initializer.seed_policy: Do not introduce an extra initializer seed or seed-dependent direction construction. Use the same worker/model initialization path as Phase 1; training-seed variation remains the fixed data-loader and rollout seed variation.

fixed_evaluation.fixed_overlap_filter: Use the same immutable conservative_union of 30 problems and require 6680 records/872 problems after filtering.

base_model_reference.protocol: Use the exact fixed evaluation snapshot and generation parameters above without any adapter.
base_model_reference.role: Absolute no-RL reference only; it is not a training-seed paired method.

i8_minus_standard_lora_r32.per_seed: Exactly matched problem-cluster bootstrap for seeds 42 and 43 with 10000 samples and random seed 42.
i8_minus_standard_lora_r32.two_seed_summary: Use the same point checks and descriptive hierarchical bootstrap algorithm as the frozen I0-versus-I8 two-seed execution spec.
i8_minus_standard_lora_r32.claim_gate: Both views must pass the seed-43 and two-seed descriptive gates from the frozen two-seed execution spec before claiming improvement over standard LoRA in this fixed setting.

i0_minus_standard_lora_r32.per_seed: Exactly matched problem-cluster bootstrap for seeds 42 and 43.
i0_minus_standard_lora_r32.role: Separate the effect of the matched random-orthogonal initialization from the P2-plus-random I8 increment.

methods_minus_base_model.role: Report absolute RL improvement/degradation without treating the base-model evaluation as a paired training-seed population comparison.

implementation_requirements_after_activa: Create a dedicated standard-LoRA rank-32 launcher; do not modify or reuse the historical rank-8/dropout-0.05 launcher as if it were protocol matched.

Create an immutable training contract that records PEFT version, initializer semantics, environment/package lock, exact configuration, code provenance, adapter hash, module count, and trainable/stored parameter counts.
Refuse an existing nonempty training directory and never silently resume or overwrite a run.
Use the same independent full-benchmark verifier and postverification artifact format as Phase 1.
Implement and test the standard-LoRA comparison by extending the already frozen two-seed gate machinery without changing thresholds or claim wording after results are visible.

reasons: Historical standard LoRA is rank 8 rather than rank 32.
Historical checkpoint contents/cadence and provenance chain differ from Phase 1.

reporting_requirements: Trainable and stored adapter parameter counts for I0, I8, and standard LoRA rank 32.
Peak GPU memory and training/evaluation wall time for every method/seed.
The P2 probe cost reported separately from I8's 50-step RL training; standard LoRA has zero probe cost.
Exact PEFT version and initializer source hashes.
Disclosure that only two training seeds were tested and seed 42 participated in I8 selection.

estimated_additional_wall_time.standard_lora_r32_two_training_and_evalu: approximately 19-21 serial hours under current measurements
estimated_additional_wall_time.note: Do not spend this compute unless the I8 two-seed fixed-model/task gate passes.

claim_policy.without_matched_standard_lora: Only superiority over the matched random-orthogonal I0 baseline may be claimed.
claim_policy.if_i8_beats_standard_lora_gate: May claim improvement over protocol-matched standard LoRA only in this fixed 1.5B math-RL setting and only for the two tested training seeds.
disallowed_even_if_passed: Broad generalization across models, tasks, domains, or datasets.
The original three-seed standard-LoRA gate passed.

researcher_degrees_of_freedom: No training seed, initializer, PEFT version, rank, alpha, dropout, target module, optimizer/RL setting, evaluation sample, filter, threshold, averaging unit, comparison orientation, or claim branch may be changed after seed-43 Phase-1 results or standard-LoRA results become available.
